label: Midday Update
headline: S&P -1.1% at 11:29, VIX 25.2, Dow -1.5% at 11:34, Nvidia reports after the close
stance: Stocks are down a second day, across tech, small caps and the Dow. The 10-year yield is 5.11% at 11:18, little changed.

scorecard.call: A strong retail sales number adds to January hike risk.
scorecard.actual: Retail sales +0.2%, as expected (8:30). Control group +0.6% vs +0.4%. 10y -0.7bp at 11:18.

scorecard.call: S&P -1.9% Monday. US futures lower (~4:48am ET).
scorecard.actual: Selling continued after the open. S&P -1.1% at 11:29, VIX 25.2.

bullets: Nasdaq -1.3% and Dow -1.5% at 11:34. Russell 2000 -1.3% at 11:19.
Semiconductor index -1.3% at 11:34, in line with the Nasdaq.
Import prices +1.1% in October vs +0.7% expected (8:30). Nonfuel import prices +0.8%.
Industrial production -0.4% in October vs +0.1% expected (9:15). Utilities output -4.3%.
Fed's Musalem said four more rate hikes may be needed in coming months (8:40).

items.head: Nvidia: Huang open to returning as CEO
items.body: Former CEO said at 11:00 he would return if the board allows. Chip stocks pared losses after (11:26).

items.head: Home Depot beats, names Richard McPhail CEO
items.body: Q3 sales $43.4bn, +4.9% (6:00). Full-year profit outlook below estimates. Shares -1.9% pre-market (10:02).

items.head: Disney beats, targets $3bn of savings
items.body: Fiscal Q4 beat estimates (9:15). Shares fell nearly 2% pre-market (9:04), then traded higher after the open (11:11).

watch.head: Nvidia results, after today's close
watch.body: First report since Huang resigned. Huang said at 11:00 he is open to returning.

watch.head: Housing starts and permits, Nov 18, 8:30
watch.body: Homebuilder index 25 in November vs 29 expected (10:00), a 14-year low.
